- Validate n is a positive integer; initialize a set to collect unique odd values and a variable curr = n.
- Generate Collatz sequence iteratively until curr == 1: if curr is odd, add to set and set curr = 3*curr + 1 (except when curr == 1, just record and stop); if even, set curr //= 2. Use integer operations to avoid floats.
- After loop, convert the set to a list and return it sorted in ascending order.
